cloudDescription.text: The cloud connection provides live and historical SAX Power data independently of the optional Modbus integration.

apiUrl.label: SAX Power API URL
apiUrl.help: Base URL of the SAX Power dashboard API.

username.label: Email address
username.help: Email address used for the SAX Power dashboard.

password.label: Password
password.help: Password used for the SAX Power dashboard.

pollInterval.label: Polling interval
pollInterval.help: Interval for retrieving live data from SAX Power.

aboutText.text: This independent community adapter connects ioBroker to the SAX Power cloud and provides live measurements, device information and energy statistics.

releaseText.text: Cloud connection, automatic device discovery, live values, documented object structure and battery energy statistics. Modbus control and intelligent charging logic are planned for a later release.

issuesLink.text: Report an issue or suggest a feature

independenceNotice.text: SAX Power and the SAX Power logo are protected brand assets of SAX Power GmbH. This adapter is an independent open-source community project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or maintained by SAX Power GmbH.

donationText.text: Development and maintenance are provided voluntarily. A donation is entirely optional and helps cover the time spent on testing, documentation and future improvements.

privacyNotice.text: The PayPal page opens only after clicking the button. The adapter itself does not transmit payment data.
